name: Clinic booking
summary: A booking platform for private clinics: patients find a doctor and book a slot online, clinic staff manage calendars and patient files, and reminders go out by SMS and e-mail.

business.customers: Private clinic chains pay per doctor; their patients book for free.
critical_flows: Search for a free slot and book it
Clinic staff open a patient file
Reminder sent 24 h before the visit

environments.name: prod
environments.purpose: Live booking API, patient database and reminders.

environments.name: staging
environments.purpose: Release candidates; full prod size, restored weekly from a prod snapshot.

environments.name: dev
environments.purpose: Shared dev database and the self-hosted CI runner.

users.definition: Patients who booked or changed a visit plus clinic staff who signed in, in 30 days.
